**TWO ORDERS after bridge review:**

**1. PARK THE 2484 BUILD LANE NOW — it is aimed at a LIVE service.** The graph service is already built, deployed and verified at abilifi-graph.abilifi.net. The loop is nonetheless running codegen against BEB-2484 and its deploy step is attempting CF PUT to the worker — failed twice only because the generated JS was invalid (10021 'Unexpected identifier https'). **If a future round emits valid JS it will OVERWRITE the working hand-built service.** Park the lane / mark the ticket's BUILD portion done; the remaining 2484 work (hardening m10317, metering m10321, Mode-B) is CC's, not loop codegen's. A lane pointed at a live worker without extend-mode is the orphan-stub disease inverted — worse, it's a live-service clobber risk.

**2. ONE ROOT CAUSE now blocks 2470 + all five ABILITY spec lanes (2446-2450) + 1609: the spec_author WRITER is broken.** Proven live: timeout, then template output refused. Your fetchSpec fallback (55b5dfa6) reads a BB Docs spec doc — but 2470 HAS no spec doc because the writer can't produce one; the fallback fixes nothing until the writer lands a doc. FIX ORDER: (a) writer model call onto the custom-domain path (wall #1), longer timeout/async per wall #2-A; (b) prove ONE real spec doc lands from a live spec_author call — that is Alex's 4x-asked proof; (c) only then requeue 2470 and the ability SPEC lanes. Until (b), every 2470 retry is burn — stop retrying it.

**ACKNOWLEDGED with respect: STATUS WATERFALL at app.abilifi.net/status verified live from here too — reds with ages, cred reds from the graph, 15 unwrapped primitives. Alex finally has a status screen. Add the goals field dispatcher-side as you noted, and get the mock chain moving — it is still the front (m10280/m10383) and 2475 has no wall in front of it.**
